exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

detonation_conditions: at pursuit timeout if a target is inside its radius

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: better single-target reliability but less crowd coverage

rules.text: Armed mines acquire the nearest enemy within 6M and pursue at 3M/s for up to 6.0 s.
They deal 150% current Damage with 85% current blast radius.
A hunter may retarget once if its target dies. It detonates on contact, at pursuit timeout if a target is inside its radius, or at normal lifetime expiry.
The branch turns a route-defense tool into slow autonomous ordnance with better single-target reliability but less crowd coverage.
